content.title: Chapter 62 - OFFENSES — Sec. 62-55. - Window peeping.
content.summary:
It shall be unlawful for any person to look, peer or peep into, or to loiter around
               or within view of, any window of a building occupied as the residence of another with
               the intent of observing any person undressed or in the act of dressing or undressing.
